name: closing-checklist
title: Closing checklist
for_each: select id,code from deals order by code

sections.title: Conditions and deliverables
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,status,revision,completion_evidence from items where deal_id=$1 and kind<>'postclosing' order by code

sections.title: Unresolved dependencies
sections.sql: select i.code item,r.code requires,r.status from dependencies dep join items i on i.id=dep.item_id join items r on r.id=dep.requires_id where i.deal_id=$1 and r.status<>'complete' order by i.code

name: signature-matrix
title: Signature evidence matrix
for_each: select id,code from deals order by code

sections.title: Current revision
sections.note: Recorded evidence is a human attestation, not electronic signature verification.
sections.sql: select s.code,s.signer,s.revision,s.signature_status,s.signed_on,s.evidence from signature_status s join items i on i.id=s.item_id where i.deal_id=$1 order by s.code,s.signer

name: closing-book-index
title: Closing book index
for_each: select id,code from deals order by code

sections.title: Readiness
sections.note: An index of references, not a merged or executed document bundle. Open items remain visible.

sections.title: Document register
sections.sql: select i.code,i.title,i.status,doc.revision,doc.reference,doc.sha256 from items i join documents doc on doc.item_id=i.id where i.deal_id=$1 order by i.code,doc.revision

sections.title: Post-closing obligations
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,status from items where deal_id=$1 and kind='postclosing' order by due_on
